decisions.reason: The client explicitly says the footer works well. Narrowing the internal header content does not change the footer's independently required content.
Omitting assessment date and vehicle group from the revised internal header does not remove their independent editability requirements elsewhere in the templates.
The internal header refinement does not alter the separately requested clean vehicle identification section.
A subtle, space-efficient internal header is consistent with the existing visual direction but does not change the broader cross-variant visual-theme state.
The source Event applies to headers on pages 2 onwards and does not change the front-page score and risk summary.
The candidate already records DX-17 as the internal-header identifier from the same message, and the source header refinement introduces no additional identifier change.
The internal-page header change does not affect the separately specified front-page result-driver content or bullet format.
Including confidential status in internal headers does not modify the separate final-page limited-distribution warning.
The revised internal-header fields do not change the independent policy for replacing raw assessment-date placeholder text.
The internal header refinement does not alter the required reusable fonts, icons, or design-asset package.
The source Event changes internal-page headers only and leaves the scoring-summary table and its fields unchanged.
Using DX-17 in the example header does not change the required DX17–DX20 variant set or its score-and-risk selection basis.
